fixes.title: Frontend Event Handling Fix
steps: Inspect the browser console for JavaScript TypeErrors.
Verify the onClick or onSubmit event binds correctly to the DOM.
Check state management (Redux/Context) for dropped updates.
fixes.explanation: UI failures generally occur when state updates are silently dropped or JavaScript throws silent errors.

fixes.title: CSS / Layout Debugging
steps: Open Chrome DevTools and inspect the element box model.
Check for unclosed CSS tags or z-index overlapping.
Verify mobile responsiveness across multiple viewport widths.
fixes.explanation: Visual bugs are frequently caused by flexbox/grid mismanagement or CSS scope bleed.

analysis.title: login not working
analysis.description: The FixGenie dual-model ML engine classified this as a Backend issue with Medium priority. Detection confidence: 37%. Context: New Issue.

fixes.title: Validate Authentication API & Payloads
steps: Check if the frontend is appending the correct Authorization headers.
Verify the JWT token expiration and signature locally.
Inspect the network tab (Status 401/403) to see which gateway is rejecting it.
fixes.explanation: Authentication issues almost always stem from malformed tokens or disconnected OAuth providers.

fixes.title: Database Credential Verification
steps: Ensure password hashing algorithms match (e.g., bcrypt vs pbkdf2).
Verify if the user's account is locked due to rate limiting.
fixes.explanation: If the API layer works, the database lookup or hash verification might be failing.
